verdict.rationale: The evidence describes a job as a chain of tasks (import → convert → export) for a single file, plus merging multiple files into one PDF and real-time task updates. None of it documents converting a whole folder or list of files in one run with per-file results. The job and task pipeline is a building block a developer could loop over, and merging files is a different capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results
